blurb: Guests can explore animal exhibits, participate in educational tours and camps, and attend special events like twilight strolls and yoga classes. The Zoo focuses on conservation and engaging people with wildlife. It features notable animals such as African penguins and red pandas.
extraNote: Cancellation for Adult Zoo Camp: $50 non-refundable fee; full refund minus fee if cancelled 10 business days prior; no refund after · Twilight Stroll full refund if cancelled two weeks before event; no refund after · Zoo cannot invoice or bill for field trip fees; payment must be made in full at time of visit · Main Gate for general admission and events; Bog Turtle Lot near Ravens Gate for bus drop-off and pick-up for school groups · Year-round
